title: Tactical Encounter Depth & Loot Collectability
master_reference_lock: V3.8 + five gameplay master references + M213/M214 camera/world composition

rules: Aggro transitions must be readable rather than binary chase loops.
Broadside firing keeps existing damage/range/reload authority.
Post-shot recover is movement/presentation state only and does not accelerate reload.
Boss phase changes expose a short readable phase-shift state.

sink_read.rule: Presentation scale differs by encounter class; health/rewards remain authoritative and unchanged.

rules: Boss salvage and repair cache must not visually overlap.
Pickup radius and reward values remain unchanged.
Loot remains in navigable water near the defeated target.

parity: Identical gameplay/world logic on mobile, web and desktop; only responsive UI sizing may differ.
